statement: EXP-0016 identifies the precise standard-HID descriptor correction: instead of consecutive Button usages 1–16, declare usages 1,2,4,5,7,8,11,12,13,14,15 followed by five constant padding bits. Linux hid-input maps Game Pad usage n through BTN_GAMEPAD + n-1, and the corrected descriptor yields expected legacy xpad X/Y numeric assignments 307/308 without changing report length, button-packing order or axes. The B virtual UHID test is SDL Linux-event/evdev acceptance, not native XUSB.
